title: Family flat
goal: A reader must be able to identify a complete three-bedroom family flat and follow the hall to every room.

rubric.must: Three separately labeled bedrooms are visible, each with its own door onto the central hall.
Living Room and Dining Room are visibly separate labeled spaces.
Two separately labeled bathrooms with sanitary fixtures are visible.
The kitchen visibly contains a counter, sink, stove, and refrigerator.
The central hall provides an unobstructed route from the entry to every bedroom and bathroom.
Door swing arcs and exterior windows are clearly visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly presents a complete three-bedroom family flat. The central hall connects the south entry to all labeled rooms, with readable door swings, exterior windows, furnishings, and sanitary/kitchen fixtures.

items.evidence: Bedroom 1, Bedroom 2, and Bedroom 3 are separately labeled and each has its own doorway onto the Central Hall.
Living Room and Dining Room are separately labeled spaces divided by a full interior wall.
Family Bathroom and Shower Room are separately labeled, and each visibly contains a toilet and sink.
The labeled Kitchen visibly contains a counter run, sink, four-burner stove, and refrigerator marked REF.
The unobstructed Central Hall runs from the south entry and provides direct door access to every bedroom, both bathrooms, the kitchen, living room, and dining room.
Door openings and swing arcs are clearly drawn, and exterior windows are visible on the living and dining west walls, kitchen north wall, Bedrooms 1 and 2 east walls, and Bedroom 3 south wall.
